reason: The hypothesis proposes a specific, previously unstated mechanism—preferential Cu surface segregation driving an inward-propagating premelting transition in FeNiCrCoCu nanoparticles—that is not reported or suggested in any passage. It synthesizes the general concept of surface-energy-driven disorder-to-order transitions from P42 with the known low melting point of Cu to create a novel, testable prediction for a different alloy system and thermal regime.
